decisions.reason: As a finish-led extension of the core drainage range, it uses the firm's existing manufacturing, design and channel knowledge well, so absorptive capacity is high and withdrawal risk is low.
This shower channel remains very close to the firm's established technical base and target customers, and the firm's own R&D and service capabilities make continued refinement and retention likely.
The stainless steel design grate fits the firm's design-engineering strengths and broad portfolio logic, so it is easy to support and unlikely to be removed soon.

Although the pump-drain concept is more complex and the earlier withdrawal of a related pump-assisted line shows some market or technical risk, the product still builds on learned drainage know-how and recent development effort, so it is more likely to be kept for further improvement than dropped immediately.
